answer: A workable defense is bonded stake: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can vote or claim rewards, like a narrow inlet that only admits one ship at a time. Creating a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand deposits, so the cost of a Sybil swarm grows in step with its size. If an identity is caught cheating, its bond is slashed, turning fraud from free into expensive. Honest agents act like a sparrow returning to the same nest: they build one reputation over time and get their bond back, while a spiral of sock-puppets collapses under its collateral cost.
